description: Migrate the highest-value resource holdouts off bespoke home-directory and shell-era storage conventions onto RESOURCE_*_DIR and the resource runtime storage layer. Focus first on resources whose data would matter most in self-hosted disaster recovery and monetized deployments, while preserving true vendor-required external paths only where unavoidable.
name: resource-storage-exception-normalization-wave
title: Normalize resource storage exceptions onto the runtime storage layer
